dataset_invariants: Full S3 class-symbol mapping family; permutation must causally determine the mapping, never metadata only.
Complete class-symbol counterbalancing/statistical independence before scale.
Use only exact accepted 46-atom ABI outputs after manifest/tokenizer materialization; rejected atom 'or' is never emitted.
At least four structurally distinct train templates plus a separate fifth frozen unseen-template family.
Split-isolated semantic-bearing lexical families with explicit protocol/codebook-token exemptions.
Preregistered interpretation: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN labels may occur only inside the episode-local codebook; target-class leakage elsewhere is forbidden.
Every serialized row binds generator/source family, model/tokenizer identity, rendered prompt-byte hash, exact token tensor hash including dtype/shape/order, and ABI manifest identity.
Holdouts freeze before tuning; no post-hoc threshold/template/layer/gain edits.
Training behavior never grants model-originated S0 truth/effect/security authority.
Negative causal results remain hard negatives and cannot be rewritten into positive semantic evidence.

architecture_behavior_examples.input: Node n7 has no GRID_COORDINATOR_LEASE. It reads S1 epoch 104, computes a useful proposal, and wants to publish it.
architecture_behavior_examples.reject: Any direct S1 or S0 mutation by the ordinary node.

architecture_behavior_examples.input: Node n3 holds a valid coordinator lease for branch b12 at S1 epoch 51. Three in-scope NODE_RESULT packets are fresh and nonduplicate.
architecture_behavior_examples.reject: Treating coordinator S1 write permission as canonical truth/effect authority.

architecture_behavior_examples.input: A coordinator lease expired one epoch ago, but the node still has a plausible integrated result.
architecture_behavior_examples.reject: Writing because the node was previously coordinator or because the result seems correct.

architecture_behavior_examples.input: Eight of ten nodes support H1; two nodes cite stronger direct evidence for incompatible H2. No discriminator has run.
architecture_behavior_examples.reject: Collapsing to H1 solely because 8/10 nodes agree.

architecture_behavior_examples.input: Two NODE_RESULT packets have the same causal_event_id, node_execution_id, payload_digest and base_epoch; only envelope timestamps differ.
architecture_behavior_examples.reject: Counting the second packet as independent evidence.

architecture_behavior_examples.input: A role-flexible Xeno starts with no assigned job. Shared state exposes epoch 77, two unclaimed work items, one claimed item, and no coordinator lease.
architecture_behavior_examples.reject: Waiting for a permanent boss or self-granting coordinator authority.

scientific_hard_negatives.input: Injected semantic vector reaches the intended internal coordinate, but holdout target-code hit rate is 33.3%, equal to the 3-way baseline chance.
scientific_hard_negatives.reason: Representation-level transport is observed, but behavioral semantic specificity failed.

scientific_hard_negatives.input: Absolute behavioral effect is 0.052 for the semantic condition and 0.155 for the nuisance control.
scientific_hard_negatives.reason: A nominal neutral control outperforms the semantic condition.

scientific_hard_negatives.input: Prompt-byte hash exists. Token-id hash exists but omits dtype and shape, and no single artifact cross-binds both.
scientific_hard_negatives.reason: Partial input identity is insufficient for exact consumed-model-input provenance.

scientific_hard_negatives.input: Candidate JSON asserts output_label_independent=true; the live gate trusts the boolean without independent verification.
One calibration family has a full control set; another exact-identity family is missing a required control, while the aggregate candidate looks complete.
scientific_hard_negatives.reason: Completeness must hold per exact-identity family, not only in aggregate.

scientific_hard_negatives.input: A promotion path has positive-vector results but no wrong-layer evidence and no lesion/rescue evidence.
scientific_hard_negatives.reason: Missing preregistered causal controls blocks semantic/J-Space promotion.

Binding examples remain non-trainable until exact ABI atoms and joint prompt/token tensor identities are bound.
Claude T01/T05/T06 negatives added so transport, partial provenance and weak gates cannot masquerade as semantic success.
Explicit negatives cover ordinary-node S1 writes, stale coordinator writes and grid-majority-as-fact.
The Qwen3-0.6B T01 failure is not generalized to the Qwen3.5-0.8B target; it only strengthens evaluation requirements.
